name: graph_query
description: Traverse the knowledge graph from a set of entities (or auto-extracted from a free-form query) and return the related chunks. Use this when you need code or context anchored to specific symbols, files, or named entities — not for general semantic search.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Natural-language query. Entities will be auto-extracted from this when 'entities' is not provided.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Explicit list of entity names to anchor the traversal. Overrides 'q' when both are provided.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum chunks to return (clamped to 1..50, default 10).
